title: Beyond the Verdict: Agentic Code Judging with Verifiable Feedback
abstract: arXiv:2610.18760v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Test-time scaling for large language models (LLMs) can involve generating multiple candidate solutions for selection or revising an earlier attempt. To guide selection and revision, we need a verifier that can estimate candidate correctness and provide evidence of failure. In competitive programming, however, official judging systems provide authoritative verdicts under finite submission budgets, without revealing failure explanations or failing inputs. To provide informative feedback without consuming official submissions, we formulate a task in which a model judges and diagnoses a candidate program using only the problem statement and source code, with generated counterexamples serving as checkable evidence. translated_title: 超越判决：基于可验证反馈的智能体代码评判
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）的测试时扩展可以涉及生成多个候选解以供选择，或对先前的尝试进行修订。为了指导选择与修订，我们需要一个能够估计候选解正确性并提供失败证据的验证器。然而，在竞技编程中，官方评测系统在有限的提交次数预算下只提供权威的判定结果，而不会揭示失败原因或导致失败的输入。为了在不消耗官方提交次数的情况下提供有信息量的反馈，我们提出了一个任务：模型仅凭问题描述和源代码来评判并诊断候选程序，并以生成的反例作为可检验的证据。为了评估这一任务，我们基于 USACO 2026 竞赛构建了 USACO-JUDGE 数据集，其中包含由人类专家和多个大语言模型编写的通过及未通过的程序。随后，我们训练了 ARBITER，一个 35B 参数的混合专家（MoE）智能体验证器……（原文摘要到此截断）
tldr: 该论文构建了 USACO-JUDGE 基准并训练了 35B 混合专家智能体验证器 ARBITER，使模型仅凭题面与代码即可评判和诊断竞技编程程序，并利用生成的反例作为可验证证据，在不消耗官方提交次数的情况下指导测试时的解选择与修订。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces USACO-JUDGE and ARBITER, a 35B MoE agentic verifier that judges and diagnoses competitive programming solutions using only the problem statement and code, employing generated counterexamples as verifiable evidence to guide test-time selection and revision without consuming official submissions.
